svg.title: Infinite world streaming
svg.desc: World::updateAroundPlayer() — 16×256×16 chunks around the player, persisted to ~/.farlands/world
svg.text: World::updateAroundPlayer() — 16×256×16 chunks around the player, persisted to ~/.farlands/world
· Runs when the player's chunk coordinate changes.
· Disk first: ChunkSerializer::load(), else generate + save.
· New chunks mark their 4 neighbours dirty → seams remesh.
· Unloaded chunks are written back before being freed.
